name: So you want to be a magical girl?
source:
A small vn about overcoming your fears to become a magical girl.

Diana is a college student who has just woken up after an attack by evil forces, she is greeted by a mysterious creature who tries to convince her to accept her deal. But if there is something Diana doesn't want is to be a hero.

[from [url=https://zejbo32.itch.io/so-you-want-to-be-a-magical-girl]itch.io[/url]]
